kind: app-screen (single-page lesson viewer) with a short overview
override: User asked explicitly for a simple, clean, transparent liquid-glass look (frosted translucent panels, soft light), not a poster. The taste skill's app-screen house rule against glass/backdrop blur is overridden by the brief; everything else (one accent, real renders, tabular digits, no gradient text, no emoji, no icon-in-tinted-square, no vanity numbers) is kept.
idea: The machine itself sits behind the glass: the active case's real render is blurred into the ground, so every frosted panel refracts the device you are studying and the whole page re-tints when you switch case.
live_thing: Switch case in place: the lesson loads inside the glass frame, the ground re-tints from its render, language and deep link (?case=) are kept.
